chapters.name: Draeid
chapters.text: The grove-keepers. They mend the hurt and bind the loud with root and thorn. Heals and plant control.

spells.name: Boildidielg
spells.text: Flings a barbed vine at a foe: {damage} nature damage and a short slow.

spells.name: Driùchdu
spells.text: A bead of cool dew heals the one you look at (yourself if none): {heal} health.

spells.name: Ribidries
spells.text: Briars burst from the ground at the target spot and hold anything in them: slow and light damage each pulse.

spells.name: Kraikenddaurach
spells.text: Your skin takes on oak bark for 12 seconds: resistance, at the cost of slowness.

spells.name: Slànachaddoiri
spells.text: A ring of green light heals you and every ally close by, and leaves a slow regrowth.

spells.name: Leimdaum
spells.text: You bound forward and up like a stag and take no damage from the fall that follows.

spells.name: Sliegoilìuk
spells.text: Hold to draw a white-berried spear of pith and thorn. A full draw pierces two foes and poisons them.

chapters.name: Fiusaichi
chapters.text: The seers. They see what is hidden and strike where a blow is already foretold. Sight, marks and blinks.

spells.name: Sraudagsieldad
spells.text: A bright flicker that stings for {damage} and leaves the target outlined for 6 seconds.

spells.name: Fradurk
spells.text: Your eyes open to the dark for 40 seconds: night vision.

spells.name: Snàddànu
spells.text: You pull on the target's thread: it is weakened and slowed for 8 seconds and takes {damage}.

spells.name: Keimskàili
spells.text: You step through the veil and appear 8 blocks ahead.

spells.name: Eòlasubradun
spells.text: Channel for 2.5 seconds: a stream of bright knowing cuts through everything in a line.

spells.name: Fairi
spells.text: Everything hostile within 14 blocks glows for 10 seconds, even behind stone.

spells.name: Boildibruodur
spells.text: You name a place and the blow falls there a heartbeat later: {damage} to everything in 3 blocks.

chapters.name: Bàrdu
chapters.text: The singers. Three strains (sleep, lament, laughter) and their thunder. Crowd control and rally.

spells.name: Bilegtàirnenach
spells.text: One struck note travels as a crackle and does {damage}.

spells.name: Tàlad
spells.text: The target's limbs go heavy: slowness and weakness for 6 seconds, and it forgets its hurry.

spells.name: Kuma
spells.text: A long falling strain: nearby foes stagger back and are struck by dread: nausea for 4 seconds.

spells.name: Gàiri
spells.text: A bright strain mends you and each ally near you for {heal} and quickens them for 4 seconds.

spells.name: Adurkglaed
spells.text: A great horn blast hammers the area in front of you: {damage} and a heavy shove.

spells.name: Òrunbrautach
spells.text: A marching song for 15 seconds: you and nearby allies gain speed and haste.

spells.name: Koseirmstoirmi
spells.text: Hold a chord for 3 seconds. The sky answers along your aim and each moment of the chord strikes.

chapters.name: Filid
chapters.text: The poets of law and satire. Their words wound, bind and shield. Curses, wards and cleansing.

spells.name: Boildirand
spells.text: A hard line of verse flies out: {damage} and a short weakness.

spells.name: Randskiad
spells.text: A spoken ward gives you a shield of 3 extra hearts for 20 seconds.

spells.name: Aeiri
spells.text: A cutting rhyme raises blisters on the proud: slowness, weakness and {damage} to the target.

spells.name: Fìrind
spells.text: A true word spoken over you and your allies strips slowing and harmful effects and heals {heal}.

spells.name: Randkeid
spells.text: A rapid recital: five small bolts fan out in a spread, each doing {damage}.

spells.name: Toirmesk
spells.text: You lay a ban on the target: withering for 5 seconds and hunger for 15.

spells.name: Maldachd
spells.text: A dark cloud of ill words settles on the target ground for 7 seconds and keeps cursing what stands in it.

chapters.name: Fitech
chapters.text: The war-crow's way. Short sharp melee strikes, battle shouts and fear. Scales with melee power.

spells.name: Boildifiendag
spells.text: Two quick strikes, like a crow at carrion. Each hits for {damage}.

spells.name: Glaedkad
spells.text: A raven-throated shout: you and allies near you gain strength for 10 seconds.

spells.name: Leimfitech
spells.text: You throw yourself forward in a low leap with a speed burst.

spells.name: Bàinid
spells.text: You fall into fury for 8 seconds: strong blows, but you take more harm (weaker defence).

spells.name: Roudspoiri
spells.text: A full spin: three sweeping cuts that hit everything around you for {damage} each.

spells.name: Oildti
spells.text: Dread shakes nearby foes: they are shoved back and weakened for 6 seconds.

spells.name: Àdbàsu
spells.text: A single heavy stroke. Foes under a third of their health take triple damage.

chapters.name: Sìtichi
chapters.text: The hollow-hill folk. Mist, glamour and gifts that come with a price. Control and mobility.

spells.name: Kietach
spells.text: A cold white mist rises where you point: it clings, slows and nips for 6 seconds.

spells.name: Loindskàili
spells.text: A veil of glamour: you are unseen for 6 seconds and quick for 3.

spells.name: Keimknok
spells.text: You step inside the hill and out again 12 blocks ahead.

spells.name: Tiudlak
spells.text: A gift from the hill: the target regains {heal} health over 10 seconds, and is lightly shielded.

spells.name: Geigairged
spells.text: A bright branch flies out and passes through two foes. Each is chilled and takes {damage}.

spells.name: Uoirsìtichi
spells.text: Time thickens around you: foes within 7 blocks crawl for 3 seconds and are nipped by frost.

spells.name: Klachmelduin
spells.text: A hail of stones falls around the target spot: {damage} to each foe struck, with a chill.

chapters.name: Gouba
chapters.text: The forge-masters. Fire from the hearth: sparks, hot iron and the long pour. Damage over time and self-tempering.

spells.name: Sraudag
spells.text: A spark spits from the fire: {damage} and burning for 3 seconds.

spells.name: Kaisk
spells.text: You plunge your hands in the quench-trough: fire resistance for 40 seconds and any fire on you goes out.

spells.name: Iarnaigitied
spells.text: Hold to heat the iron. A full draw hurls a white-hot bolt that does {damage} and sets the foe alight.

spells.name: Kaisiiarnaigi
spells.text: You temper your body for 10 seconds: haste, strength and resistance, then a short tiredness.

spells.name: Skòdsaliaruind
spells.text: A cloud of hot slag settles at the target spot for 6 seconds and keeps burning what stands in it.

spells.name: Anuilkum
spells.text: Channel the bellows for 2.5 seconds: a lance of heat along your aim, burning all it crosses.

spells.name: Oiskiliegti
spells.text: A rain of molten iron falls around the target spot: {damage} to each drop's blast and burning.
